findings.source_quote: ὅτι τρυφεραὶ οὕτως οὖσαι ἀνδρείως εἱστήκεισαν ὡς μέλλουσαι ὅλον τὸν οὐρανὸν βαστάζειν.
findings.english_quote: They looked so delicate, but stood bravely, as if they were going to carry the whole heaven.
findings.issue: “Looked so delicate” changes the source's assertion that the virgins were delicate into an assertion about their appearance. The Greek contrasts their actual delicacy with their courageous stance; it does not qualify their delicacy with an appearance expression.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed for fresh review: “They were so delicate, but stood bravely, as if they were going to carry the whole heaven.”

summary: Both editions were reviewed clause by clause against the supplied working Greek. The standard preserves the selected source's content and distinctions. The simplified requires one minor correction to preserve the assertion of the virgins’ delicacy. Both retain the negations, the Lord/shepherd distinction, and the visionary scale. The notes accurately reflect the supplied bounded Amherst report without treating restored letters as fully preserved text. The disclosed construal of συνετὸς ὤν is acceptable here without claiming it is the only interpretation. This review does not authenticate unseen editions or manuscript images, certify exhaustive collation, or automatically approve the proposed replacement.
